verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships its own AI agent, so connecting external MCP servers to it is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Customer.io's own MCP server, which external AI clients connect to; that is the server role and does not count toward this client story. Nothing shows Customer.io's agent can connect to or use tools from third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
